item.title: In Sydney’s Shadow, Green Menorah Lighting Shines
item.description: Less than a day after two gunmen killed at least 15 people and injured dozens more at a Hanukkah celebration on a beach in Sydney, Australia, over 100 people gathered on the New Haven Green Sunday evening for an annual menorah lighting ceremony that sent a little bit of light into the darkness. The post In Sydney’s Shadow, Green Menorah Lighting Shines appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Zoners Reject Backyard Buildup’s Parking Plan
item.description: The Board of Zoning Appeals (BZA) denied a local landlord's request to make room for a couple of parking spots between an existing single-family house and four planned new apartments on that same Orchard Street lot. The post Zoners Reject Backyard Buildup’s Parking Plan appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Atticus Bakes It To 50
item.description: These days, Atticus Bookstore Cafe looks a little different than it did in 1975. For one, the cafe part didn't exist when the downtown staple first opened its doors. Customers were rushing to buy Alex Haley's blockbuster novel Roots; now, they're buying Samin Nosrat's newest cookbook, Good Things. The post Atticus Bakes It To 50 appeared first on New Haven Independent.
